name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key' is RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard ('also' is a no-timing cue). 'Then pick up the box in the other room' opens with the order word Then after the if-sentence, so it requires Existence(target_picked_up) hard, Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) hard, and Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) hard, all present. The redundant R1 stays because the task states that if-rule. All priorities are hard, matching the absence of any preference cue.

texts: If the blocking ball is moved, the agent must also acquire the matching door key at some point.
Eventually pick up the target box in the other room.
The matching door key must be acquired before the target box is picked up.
If the blocking ball is moved, the target box must eventually be picked up afterward.
